question: Who among the following was the founder of the Khilji Dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jalal-ud-din Firoz Khilji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jalaluddin Khilji is known as the founder of the Khilji dynasty in India.
 
• He ruled from 1290 AD to 1296 AD. 
 
• He gave shelter to many Mongols after their conversion to Islam during his reign.
 
• He defeated the Mongols.
